meta.question: did flooded (reported) places gain more built-up surface since 2000 than equally-built places that were never reported?

sources.builtup: GHSL GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, 100 m Mollweide, tile R9_C19, CC BY 4.0 (European Union, GHSL R2023A)
sources.land_mask: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0 (ESA WorldCover 10 m v200, 2021)

method.filtering: location_confidence 'lga' excluded; duplicates within 200 m in the same event removed (first kept)
method.catch: flood reports come from where people are, so reported points look more built-up whatever the cause; the comparison is therefore matched on 2020 built-up level, not on land at large
method.matching: for each point, 20 random land cells with b2020 within +/- 0.05 of the point's cell; cells holding any evidence point excluded; d2000_2020 compared with a stratified permutation test (10,000 shuffles, seed 20261017)
method.lagoon_subset: points within 2000 m of the Lagos/Lekki lagoon shoreline (OSM), where reclamation is most likely

caveats: small sample: a few hundred geolocated reports across five events
1 km cells are coarse: a report and its cell average very different ground
GHSL under-detects informal settlements (dense, low-rise, metal roofs) and small structures; absolute built fractions are lower bounds in such areas
GHSL epochs are model output: Landsat supports 1975/1990/2000/2014, Sentinel-2 2018; 2020 is interpolated, 2025 is a projection
evidence locations are mostly neighbourhood centroids, not the flooded spot
background matched only on b2020; unmeasured confounders (elevation, drainage, population density) are not controlled

matched on b2020, controls with the same 2020 built-up level can have reached it recently (high gain) while reported core areas were already built by 2000 (saturated, low gain): a negative difference mainly reflects saturation and reporting patterns, not protection

background.land_definition: WorldCover-2021 land at cell centre or quarter points, or any built-up in any epoch
background.matching: b2020 within +/- 0.05 of the evidence point's cell

permutation.statistic: median over points of (evidence d2000-2020 - median of matched background d2000-2020)
permutation.method: within-stratum label exchange; evidence value shuffled with its 20 matched background cells
